author: Lynn Lagasse
text: Tom conducted a Title 5 Inspection at my father's home.  He is very thorough in his work and was very honest and considerate in dealing with my elderly parent. He made a few minor improvements to the system to bring it up to compliance standards and did not try to sell repairs that were frivolous or unnecessary. Finding and recommending a contractor with integrity is my pleasure! Thank You Tom

author: Chris Dziok
text: Tom was awesome. He's knowledgeable and works quickly. He even came out on a Saturday morning to get work done before an open house. Definitely hire him for inspections and septic work.

author: elizabeth w sullivan
text: After speaking with several Septic Inspectors we contacted Tom.  I’m glad I did. He was extremely knowledgeable and professional in his approach. We had a challenging septic situation due to the placement of the system but this didn’t deter him at all. Throughout the process Tom was thoughtful and practical in his advise which resulted in a great experience. I would highly recommend Tom if you need a Septic Inspector with reasonable prices.

author: Willard Plummer
text:
Tom is a fantastic professional inspector! Extremely knowledgeable in his profession. He explained every detail of the inspection. I am a disabled AF Veteran, he was kind enough to dig out the covers to septic tank and D box for me as I was unable to do because of my disability.  Tom is a very friendly individual. I would highly recommend him for any aspect of his profession!
HP Plummer

author: Daniel Curtis
text: We used Tom for our septic inspection. He was very knowledgeable, professional and thorough. His prices were very reasonable and he was also able to bring the necessary tools and parts needed to raise and grade the access covers of our septic system so that they would be easier to access for further service and inspections.
